data.title: misc(treemap): vary colors within bundle, update fonts
data.body:
ref #16400

* Uses a color of varying saturation/lightness based on depth within each bundle. This could be tweaked more, not perfect
* Applies some font styling to better match mocks
* Splits up captions into separate elements to style differently
* Removes root node caption for "All" scripts

items.body:
Overall I think this is good.

I know this came up in the UX sync but I would strongly prefer to a permanent border on each node. It can be hard to tell the difference between different levels of shading for some colors:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb14c814-de58-4b2f-92ca-4ca495f9d4f2

Also, not sure if this issue was there before but some of the text doesn't pass our own fg/bg ratio requirements.

https://googlechrome.github.io/lighthouse/viewer/?gist=8c2c4789c3cfe2ad99f43ecbbe39663c
Yeah I could see us adding the border back. Let's stick to the design for now but will get a round of feedback when closer to done.
